programme: MYB drives a G1/S-G2/M transcriptional programme antagonised by the atypical repressor E2F7; HCFC1 and KMT2E converge on the same core targets (E2F1, CDC6, CCNA2), consistent with their known role as SET1/MLL(COMPASS)-family chromatin-complex partners gating those loci; SMARCA4 (SWI/SNF ATPase) remodels chromatin at overlapping cell-cycle/tumour-suppressor targets (CDKN1A, CDKN2A, CCND1, CDH1). Together this is a proliferation-control module: transcription factors driving cell-cycle gene expression, checked by a repressive E2F arm, gated by chromatin regulators.
role_in_a: In blood, this module would be read out as the proliferative transcriptional state of a dividing leukocyte subpopulation (MYB/E2F-driven G2/M gene expression), but nothing in the record ties it to fibromyalgia specifically: no Open Targets association for any of the five factors, and the one retrieved 'GSC' hit for fibromyalgia turns out to be an acronym collision with gadolinium storage condition, not the gene. This role is inferred from the factors' general biology, not documented for the disease.
role_in_b: In thymoma, the module plausibly runs proliferative transcription in the tumour epithelium: SMARCA4 is a documented recurrently altered gene in mediastinal epithelial neoplasms (PMID 42427482), and MYB and KMT2E carry high Open Targets association percentiles (0.86 and 0.81 of 2245 scored genes) with more moderate support for the paralogue MYBL2 (0.53, though MYBL2 itself was discordant between the diseases and is not counted as a carrying factor here). This places most of the named factors in thymoma's genetic-association record, even without functional papers.
shared_axis: Both tissues can contain a proliferating cell fraction (thymic epithelial tumour cells; a subset of circulating leukocytes), so the same E2F/MYB-driven cell-cycle transcriptional machinery, gated by HCFC1-KMT2E chromatin assembly and SMARCA4 remodeling, could in principle be read out in either. The record does not establish that this is disease-driven in fibromyalgia rather than a generic reflection of which cells happen to be dividing in the sampled blood.
reasoning: The five factors form a real, nameable proliferation/chromatin module (E2F-MYB axis plus HCFC1-KMT2E complex assembly and SMARCA4 remodeling at shared loci), and the retrieved record places most of them in thymoma via one on-topic paper (SMARCA4) and several Open Targets percentiles. But nothing in the record connects this module to fibromyalgia at all, so the cross-disease link rests on reasoning about proliferating blood cell populations, not on anything retrieved — the evidence is real but entirely asymmetric between the two diseases.
support: PMID 42427482 — describes recurrent molecular alterations, including SMARCA4, in mediastinal epithelial neoplasms (thymoma); no PMID found that discusses MYB, E2F7, HCFC1, or KMT2E in thymoma or fibromyalgia specifically, and no PMID found for any of the five carrying factors in fibromyalgia.
how_to_falsify: Run scRNA-seq or Ki67/MCM2 staining on PBMCs from a fibromyalgia cohort matched to healthy controls: if there is no elevated cell-cycle/S-G2M gene signature, and expression or ChIP occupancy of MYB, E2F7, HCFC1, KMT2E, or SMARCA4 target genes does not track with any expanding leukocyte subset, the module has no authentic disease role in fibromyalgia and the observed concordance is more likely a covariate (cell-composition, batch, or medication) effect than shared biology.
caveats: Only 1 independent cohort pair underlies all 40 patient-group comparisons, so counts like 40/40 (GRHL2) reflect repeated subgroupings of one cohort pair, not independent replications. Thymus is a naturally proliferative organ (thymocyte development), so an E2F/MYB signature there is close to tissue-generic even though it was not on the exclusion list — read the thymoma side cautiously for that reason. The tissue-generic exclusion list is dominated by classic immune transcription factors (IRF4, IRF5, BCL6, CIITA, BCL3, JUNB, FOS, KLF9, CREB5, EZH2, PBX1) and FOXO1 despite 0.9 recurrence — meaning the more obvious immune-activation story linking thymoma's paraneoplastic autoimmunity to proposed neuroimmune dysregulation in fibromyalgia was deliberately stripped out before ranking; what remains is this less obvious proliferation/chromatin story. MYBL2, MYB's closest paralogue, met the concordance threshold (26/40) but was directionally discordant between the two diseases and was excluded from the carrying set for that reason. GRHL2, MYRF, GSC, HMGB2, MYF6, and KDM2B are concordant and recur but do not share targets or complex membership with this module (epithelial junctions, myogenesis, gastrulation patterning, and p53/apoptosis nodes respectively) and are not part of this account.
